lurkapi.description: Remote MCP server and API for public social media data: profiles, posts, comments, video transcripts and Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn ad library results from 16 platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, LinkedIn and more), one tool per endpoint. Read-only. Sign in with OAuth in the browser or send an x-api-key header; 100 free credits on signup, no card.
